title: (#6106) AI Architect — Enterprise Multi-Agent Platform
job_description:
Job title: AI Architect — Enterprise Multi-Agent Platform

Location: Remote

Duration: 12+ Months

Key Responsibilities:

Define the enterprise architecture for large-scale multi-agent AI systems.
Design platforms and frameworks for the full agent lifecycle: development, testing, deployment, monitoring, versioning, and retirement.
Establish patterns for agent orchestration, agent-to-agent collaboration, tool use, memory, RAG, and human-in-the-loop workflows.
Architect an agent control plane/registry to manage identity, permissions, dependencies, ownership, risk, and lifecycle across hundreds of agents.
Build enterprise standards for security, Responsible AI, observability, evaluation, and governance.
Partner with engineering, cybersecurity, data, scientific, regulatory, and business teams to deploy AI safely at scale.
Evaluate emerging AI/agent technologies and establish scalable reference architectures.

Qualifications

10+ years in software, cloud, distributed systems, or enterprise architecture.
Significant hands-on experience with GenAI, LLMs, AI agents, and multi-agent architectures.
Demonstrated experience building platforms that manage large numbers of AI agents or autonomous workflows.
Strong knowledge of cloud platforms, APIs, microservices, AI/ML infrastructure, and distributed systems.
Experience with AI security, governance, evaluation, and observability.
Pharmaceutical, healthcare, or other highly regulated industry experience is highly desirable.

Ideal Candidate

A hands-on enterprise architect who has moved beyond building individual AI applications and has experience designing the platform and operating model required to scale AI agents from dozens to hundreds—with the security, governance, reliability, and controls required for a highly regulated pharmaceutical environment.

Pay: $90.00 - $100.00 per hour

Work Location: Remote
